title: Grilled Prawn Skewers with German-Style Herb Marinade
description: A flavorful and healthy dish inspired by German cuisine, featuring succulent prawns marinated in a blend of herbs and grilled to perfection.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine parsley, dill, garlic, German mustard, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper. Blend until smooth.
Add the marinade to a large bowl and add the prawns. Toss to coat and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the prawns onto skewers, leaving a small space between each prawn.
Brush the skewers with light olive oil and season with salt and black pepper.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the prawns are pink and cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley and lemon wedges if desired.
